test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting on a bench facing north. A is sitting second to the right of C, who is an immediate neighbour of D. E is sitting to the immediate left of A. F is an immediate neighbour of both just D and B. If B is sitting at one extreme end of the bench, then who among the following is sitting at the other extreme end?
solution:
**Given: **Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting on a bench facing north.

(1): B is sitting at one extreme end of the bench. So, there have two possibilities

Case(I): 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e45ab6c28dfbbe964fe85ceed50343bb1553571dba370d6129b0947961eed608.png] 

Case (II):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1b94365dafcfd759ee93ae82a89b95f162b8ac3bff3ec504dfca55fb8c0ece2.png] 

(2): F is an immediate neighbour of both just D and B.

Case(I):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1773d6b6349ce91455d6ce5a4f37ff68fd962a0f860a3c94dda07d4e5c564d08.png] 

Case (II):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03218301ae817a39ec055a3bb9167224379a871304fcec2f3559b49a75d952a1.png] 

(3): A is sitting second to the right of C, who is an immediate neighbour of D. i.e. **A is sitting second to the right of C and C is an immediate neighbour of D.**

So, Case (II) is eliminated. 

Case (I):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79fa8a010bac79bd07dedd0c7a72cec9f53865e2a8da9dd2d22f82ade781759b.png] 

Then, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b965d9377e77173c71e4b0d9b558cb5da473baa378fd01cc53dd741776de602.png] 

Therefore, **A** is sitting at the other extreme end. 

Hence, the correct answer is** A.**
